[ROUND 1 — claude-code, engaging composer, claude-opus-4-6, gemini]

Q1 YES — Adopt composer 27-section frame: Composer's product doctrine (§27), personas, FR-IDs, and non-goals provide the necessary altitude. Opus-4-6 correctly notes this is the product frame; engineering detail belongs in appendices. I support the merged structure: composer body + opus appendices.

Q2 YES — Engineering appendices mandatory: The 30+ Monday column IDs from monday-mapping.config.ts, route surface enumeration, and Presidio contract with CI/runtime/test enforcement are what prevent Wave 3 from becoming opinion. I support opus-4-6's appendix layout (A-F) as the engineering layer.

Q3 YES — Pure Monday proxy for candidate truth: At 238 candidates, caching introduces drift with zero performance justification. Prisma holds: opaque monday_item_id keys, derived analytics (TTL), sessions, events, interventions. NO Candidate table. NO editable mirror. Read path: Monday GraphQL. composer's clarification on 'derived analytics cache' vs 'candidate truth' is the correct distinction.

Q4 YES — Lock 3 personas: Candidate, HQ, Field. Recruiter and leadership deprecated per schema. HQ = admin. Monday owner columns handle pipeline ownership.

Q5 YES — Presidio structural enforcement: Composer's 5 mechanisms (CI import gate, runtime fail-closed, 50-prompt harness, deploy replay, audit receipts) plus gemini's adversarial hallucinated PII testing. I specifically support opus-4-6's 'no bypass flag in prod' as product-level acceptance criteria. Degradation: if Presidio down, LLM features hard 503. No fallback.

Q6 YES — 6-wave structure: Wave 0 foundation, Wave 1 PRD finalization (agree with composer's naming tweak), Wave 2 scaffold, Wave 3 routes, Wave 4 UI port, Wave 5 validation. Each wave has falsifiable done-criterion. Prevents compound-change-death.

Degraded-read behavior (Q3/Q5 edge case):
- Monday unavailable: Last-known display snapshots, read-only, STALE-labeled, writes blocked. NOT a Candidate cache, NOT an editable mirror.
- Presidio unavailable: All LLM-backed features 503. Hard fail-closed.

These must be acceptance criteria (appendix F), not implementation notes.

Convergence status: All 6 questions aligned with composer + opus-4-6 + gemini. Supporting the united PRD structure.
